subject.title: [Feature Request] Group pairing flow: notify owner + read-only mode for unconfigured groups

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared group-pairing lifecycle, and should unapproved groups be metadata-only by default or allowed to feed a restricted observation agent?
rationale: This choice defines a durable authorization and data-exposure boundary across channels; existing DM pairing and the merged DM hook do not determine the group identity, notification, persistence, or pre-approval-content contract.

options.title: Adopt metadata-only group pairing
options.body: Add pending group approval with owner notification and approved/rejected state, while dropping group messages entirely until approval.

options.title: Include restricted observation
options.body: Allow a deliberately sandboxed reader-agent mode before approval, with a separately specified data-exposure and retention contract.

options.title: Keep existing group controls
options.body: Retain allowlist, disabled, and channel-specific unknown-group behavior without adding a shared pairing lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Adopt metadata-only group pairing
recommendation.body: Add pending group approval with owner notification and approved/rejected state, while dropping group messages entirely until approval.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history is the strongest available connection to the shared group-policy, pairing, and channel access paths that a cross-channel design would change.
